title: noahshinn/reflexion
summary: Reflexion is a framework that enables language agents to improve their performance through verbal reinforcement learning and self-reflection, allowing LLMs to learn from past mistakes without gradient-based training. Presented at NeurIPS 2023, it introduces a novel approach where agents verbally reflect on failures and adjust future decisions accordingly.
problem_solved: Enables language model agents to continuously improve their decision-making by learning from failures through a verbal self-reflection mechanism instead of expensive retraining.
why_valuable: Provides a lightweight, compute-efficient method to enhance LLM agent reliability and task completion rates without requiring traditional ML fine-tuning or gradient updates.
